parsed.notes:
Required Skills and AI Experience default to required; Preferred Experience is optional. Its unmapped technical qualifications are nice-to-have.
The preference in 'Angular (preferred latest versions)' modifies versions, not the requirement for Angular.
Azure OpenAI is provisionally mapped to openai-api; the taxonomy lacks a dedicated Azure OpenAI entry.
Azure service names without matching entries remain unmapped rather than implying broader skills such as serverless or object storage.
Knowledge retrieval and document intelligence are read literally, without assuming RAG or structured data extraction.
Healthcare business domains and unspecified care-management platforms are excluded as domain knowledge, not technical skills.
Company-description, Why Join Us, responsibilities-only technologies, and promotional hashtags do not establish candidate requirements.
Java / Spring Boot is not treated as an alternative group: the slash does not explicitly offer either skill in place of the other.
Both advertised openings are explicitly senior; architecture experience is also expressly requested.
